entities.summary: Aleh Mikalajewitsch Hulak (Belorussian Алег Мікалаевіч Гулак, Russian Олег Николаевич Гулак, Oleg Nikolajewitsch Gulak; was a Belarusian human rights defender. He was the chairman of the Belarusian Helsinki Committee. He was regarded as a leader of the Belarus human rights movement.
